description: Search B2B decision-makers and company employees filtered by employer slug/domain, job title seniority (VP, CTO, Founder), keyword, and location (2 Credits per returned person, 0 Credits when empty).

limit.description: Maximum number of matching people to return per page (1–50, default: 10).

query.description: Free-text keyword filter across headline, title, and bio.

title.description: Role or seniority filter (e.g. "VP Engineering", "CTO", "Head of Growth").

name: b2b_search_decision_makers

outputSchema.description: Paginated list of matching B2B decision-makers and employees.

count.description: Number of people returned in this response.

freshness.description: Data freshness metadata indicating cache status and upstream capture timestamp.

age_seconds.description: Age of the returned snapshot in seconds.

cached.description: True when served from warm cache; false on live upstream fetch.

source_fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when upstream data was captured.

meta.description: Request execution telemetry, credit cost, and cache metadata.

cache_hit.description: Whether the record was served from hot PostgreSQL/Redis cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on 404/empty/error).
